name: Inngest Hobby
free_limit: Inngest Cloud Free: 50,000 executions/month, 500,000 events/month, 5 concurrent steps, 5 seats and 3 workers
watch_out: No card required. A single function run and every step execution each consume one execution (five steps use six executions). Free includes 100,000 queue depth, 50 concurrent realtime connections and 24-hour trace/log history; function runs can sleep for at most 30 days. Extra compute/sandbox resources may be billed separately.
